name: Flintlock Kick
description: Secondary ability: consume all 1–9 loaded gunpowder to shoot a small black ball. The powder component deals 3–11 damage, then adds 20% of current spell power and 30% of current physical attack damage. More powder means stronger recoil. A successful hit gives Darkness, Blindness and Slowness I for one second. Aim downward to launch yourself upward. One-second firing cooldown.
